title: preCICE Tutorial Metadata
description: Schema for tutorial metadata.yaml files that describe a preCICE tutorial, its participants, and available solver cases.

name.description: Human-readable name of the tutorial (e.g., 'Flow over heated plate').

path.description: Relative path of the tutorial directory within the tutorials repository (e.g., 'flow-over-heated-plate').

url.description: URL to the tutorial's documentation page on precice.org.

participants.description: The list of coupling participants in the simulation (e.g., ['Fluid', 'Solid']).

cases.description: A mapping of case names to their definitions. Each case represents a solver setup for a specific participant.

case.description: A case definition specifying which participant it serves, the directory, run command, and which component (adapter) it uses.

participant.description: The participant this case belongs to. Must match one of the entries in the top-level 'participants' list.

directory.description: Relative path to the case directory within the tutorial (e.g., './fluid-openfoam').

run.description: The command to execute this case (typically './run.sh').

component.description: Name of the component (adapter) from components.yaml that this case uses (e.g., 'openfoam-adapter', 'fenics-adapter').
